# Cache policy fixtures

Sanitized configuration evidence from the explicitly reviewed September 15–17, 2026 public-cache rollouts. optimized.json includes seven domains with complete historical and optimized request/response phases. guard-1.0.1.php through guard-1.0.3.php are the reviewed persistent helper sources; their hashes establish compatibility, not ownership of arbitrary files by filename. Troy trace/verification JSON records past provider evidence, not a new live test. No API credentials are included.

New template expressions derive from the reviewed Troy proposal, with canonical hostname and managed reference placeholders. Existing optimized policies are adopted as-is; migration exercises use copies only and never write to these zones.
